comment.body: A right-Shift-only mapping should not remap left Shift. Could you share a sanitized screenshot of the mapping row and say whether it is under Remap a key or Remap a shortcut, whether the source displays Shift (Right) or plain Shift, and whether another Shift mapping is active? This key-identity distinction is the next useful discriminator.

known_information: The report identifies PowerToys 0.100.2 from the Store and says a right-Shift-only remap affects left Shift.
There are no supplied mapping details or diagnostic attachments establishing whether the stored source is right Shift or generic Shift.
initial_investigation: Read the complete issue body and public discussion, current ownership, labels and linked-work history.
Read the complete report and absence of follow-up mapping details.
KeyboardManagerEngineLibrary explicitly handles VK_LSHIFT, VK_RSHIFT and VK_SHIFT, so these identities cannot be treated as interchangeable evidence.
inferences: Generic VK_SHIFT selection or left/right key normalization could produce the symptom; the report does not distinguish configuration from engine behavior.

information_gaps.how_to_collect: Reply with the relevant mapping row only, and test left Shift and right Shift separately.
information_gaps.why_needed: This separates a generic Shift configuration from loss of right-specific identity in the editor or engine.

title: Remapping right shift also affects left shift.

confidence.rationale: The expected behavior is clear, but no supplied mapping proves the editor stored right-specific identity.

plan: Confirm the stored source key and whether this is a single-key or shortcut remap.
Compare physical left/right Shift events with the configured source identity.
If right-specific identity is lost, correct that conversion boundary and add separate left/right/generic Shift cases.
proposed_fixes.title: Preserve left/right Shift identity
proposed_fixes.root_cause: The mapping may store generic Shift or normalize right Shift into a generic identity; the precise failing boundary is not established.
verification: A right-Shift-only remap leaves left Shift unchanged.
Generic Shift mappings intentionally cover both sides and shortcut handling stays compatible.
